text: Motor ratings shall be the next standard IEC size above the mechanical duty plus margin of DEC-EPCE-0014 (pumps +10 % flow, +5 to +10 % head). Motors shall be IEC 60034-1 duty S1, insulation class F with temperature rise class B, service factor 1.0, efficiency class IE3 or better (IE4 for continuously running LV motors above 75 kW).
